# Fixtures for `xlsx` (Excel workbook)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. People, places,
companies and addresses (Saltmere, `example.org`, `*.example`) are fictitious.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `fees.xlsx` | Assembled part by part by `scripts/fixtures/craft_documents.py` | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-dues-xlsxwriter.xlsx` | Written by the rust_xlsxwriter crate (`scripts/fixtures/office_gen`); properties, a hidden sheet, a formula, a defined name, a note, a link | CC0-1.0 |
| `berths-simple.xlsx` | Written by the simple_excel_writer crate (`scripts/fixtures/office_gen`); no core properties | CC0-1.0 |
